entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi, Charlie. I... I hope you can help. I need to return a VeloBand Cadence Sensor I bought. I just... it's been a really difficult month.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have the order number handy?

Yes, it's VF886-01. I know it's been a little while. My father had a medical emergency right after it arrived. We've basically been living at the hospital. He needed unexpected surgery, and it's just been one thing after another.

I'm so sorry to hear about your father; I hope he's recovering well. Thank you for that order number. I see you received the VeloBand 27 days ago. To make sure I'm getting you the right solution, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the band or more of a preference issue?

Oh, no, it's not broken. I haven't even used it. With everything going on, I just... I can't use it now, and honestly, with the medical bills, I really needed this money back. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, I was really hoping you could understand.
I completely understand, and thank you for being a long-time member of the VeloFit community. Your loyalty means a lot to us. Let me just pull up the return policy for this specific item. One moment.

Okay, I have good news. The VeloBand Cadence Sensor falls under our standard 90-day return policy. Since it's only been 27 days, you are well within the window for a full refund. We don't even need to process an exception.
Oh, really? Ninety days? That's… that's such a relief. I was so worried. Thank you so much.

It's my pleasure. And listen, I see here that you're a VIP member. Given the circumstances with the family emergency, I'd also like to add a $25 credit to your VeloFit account, just as a small gesture. You can use it whenever you're ready. I'm sending the pre-paid return label to your email now.
Wow, Charlie, you didn't have to do that. That's incredibly kind. This helps more than you know. Thank you.

You are very welcome. We're here to support our customers, especially when things get tough. Once our warehouse receives the return, you'll see the refund on your original payment method in 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist with?
No, that was everything. Thank you again for being so helpful.
Of course. My best wishes to your father for a speedy recovery. Have a good day.
